title: AdCP Extension Registry
description: Auto-generated registry of formal AdCP extensions. Extensions provide typed schemas for vendor-specific or domain-specific data within the ext field. Agents declare which extensions they support in their agent card.

adcp.title: AdCP-owned extensions
adcp.description: AdCP Working Group-owned extension namespace. The opportunity binding carries the published 3.2 planning-cycle object on get_products. Sellers opt in through extensions_supported; support applies to documented bindings, not arbitrary future features. Core fields take precedence where the selected task defines them.
